messages:
olivia: SLO alert just fired for hosted-infer: EUW1 p99 timeout spike + several inbound customer escalations reporting 502/504s. Support ticket #9876 linked. Anyone oncall who can triage?

support-bot: New support ticket created: #9876 (customer: AcmeCorp). Assigned to: oncall-eu. See https://support.internal/9876 :rotating_light:

vikram: linking dashboards — can you paste the alert query and a couple sample request_ids?

olivia: alert: hosted-infer.euw1.p99_latency > 2s for 5m. dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/hosted-infer/euw1/latency
sample request_ids: rq_3f9a1c, rq_3f9a85, rq_3f9b40
here's a quick log snippet from edge-proxy for rq_3f9a1c:
```
2026-03-17T10:12:33Z ingress edge-proxy request_id=rq_3f9a1c upstream=preflight-prefetch status=502 msg="handshake timeout after 250ms"
2026-03-17T10:12:33Z prefetcher request_id=rq_3f9a1c host=batcher-2 attempt=1 msg="no handshake response"
```

maya: any auth/billing correlation? sometimes billing auth failures cascade into 5xx.

olivia: quick scan — only 3/120 failed with 401s earlier (likely unrelated). majority are 502/504 prefetched handshake timeouts. tracing shows a gap between ingress->prefetch->batcher for many of these request_ids (no batcher span).

jordan: gap in spans — are we sampling or dropping traces at the proxy? 

olivia: tracing looks dropped at the prefetch hop, span IDs present on ingress but not forwarded. sample trace missing batcher segment: "trace_id=tx_9c12f span=ingress->prefetch -> MISSING". links: https://traces.internal/tx_9c12f

vikram: can you run a log query across 5m window to correlate: `service:edge-proxy AND env:euw1 AND status:502 | group_by request_id, count()` — want to see if these are concentrated behind one prefetch pod or a region.

olivia: ran that, top 3 failing pods: prefetch-2(44%), prefetch-7(31%), prefetch-3(18%). looks concentrated.

maya: can we repro in staging? if it's a concurrency/handshake edge case maybe depends on request size / kvcache state.

vikram: I'll try a repro with a long prompt and prefetch enabled. repro steps I'll run and paste:
```
# repro curl to staging
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
  -H "X-Debug: 1" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: rq-repro-0001" \
  --data '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"'$(python -c 'print("x"*12000)')'"}' \
  https://staging-api.redwood/hosts/infer?prefetch=true
```

vikram: first run in staging produced a 502 with same handshake msg, stacktrace points to prefetchtls: `handshake deadline exceeded`.

jordan: is this a cert rotation or TLS handshake param mismatch? any recent config pushes to prefetch?

olivia: config diff: prefetch TLS keepalive changed 3 days ago from 30s->5s (PR #4123). that could reduce handshake time for cold connects.

maya: that sounds suspect. shorter keepalive + high burst could cause more renegotiation and timeouts. revert to 30s as mitigation?

vikram: quick mitigation options:
- increase prefetch handshake timeout from 250ms -> 500ms at the ingress proxy (immediate toggle)
- revert TLS keepalive to 30s in prefetch (safer, requires deploy)
- route a % of traffic to fallback model (smaller model) to reduce batcher load

olivia: prefer short-term timeout bump + 10% fallback routing while we validate revert. Jordan can you approve route change?

jordan: approve. I'll create a canary route to fallback-model at 10% now.

vikram: pushing ingress timeout bump to 500ms (will take ~2m). I'll monitor p99.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1889 "EUW1 prefetchtls handshake timeouts" — oncall pager notified.

olivia: thanks — after timeout bump p99 dropped from 2.3s -> 1.1s for the last 5m. customer escalations paused. keep watching traces for gaps.

maya: started a revert PR for TLS keepalive (PR #4180) targeting canary prefetch pods, will run canary deploy when green.

vikram: after canary, if no regression I'll roll to 100% and then remove fallback route. ETA 30m for full rollback depending on canary results.

olivia: update support ticket and notify customers of mitigation. will collect a small set of request_ids to attach to the postmortem.

jordan: noted. thumbs up once rollback complete and traces show no gap. :thumbsup:

olivia: ack — will follow up with postmortem and dashboard snapshots. thanks team.
